The main takeaway from our work is that
compact modes are not a speciality of the nonlinear sigma model, but rather are a general feature of nonlinear field theories that are Lorenz invariant and have finite wave speeds.
the addition of a site potential to a Lorentz invariant model, which is otherwise devoid of any subquadratic terms, is sufficient to produce compact localized modes.
